title: TUI command descriptors are not exact copyable commands
description: Evidence: packages/ui-model/src/tui-contracts.ts builds displayCommand with plain join(" "), so spaced values such as --reason "closed from TUI" are not shell-quoted; apps/tui/src/loaders.ts reserve actions omit --workspace, --agent, --purpose, and --json even though docs/architecture/TUI_SURFACE_CONTRACTS.md requires exact scoped commands. Impact: copied commands can parse differently or target the wrong workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: TUI descriptors render shell-safe display commands and include required workspace/agent/json context where the action contract requires it, with tests for spaced arguments.
